text:
mai_pm: Small creative sprint for Jun 12 webinar — need a tidy asset bundle for launch comms and the deck.

mai_pm: Deliverables: 1) Landing hero (1600x600) + email hero (1200x628) static, 2) benchmark slide (1920x1080) with a simplified scatter (latency ms vs $/1k tokens) showing Hosted / Dedicated / Private and a translucent overlay demonstrating reduced effective cost after caching/routing, 3) a 1panel visual teardown (1200x600) extracted from the slide for social, 4) set of social assets (square 1080x1080, story 1080x1920 loop OK <1.5MB, linkedin 1200x627), 5) SVG micro-diagram for the product one-pager. Locales: EN/FR/NL. Deadline: EOD Wed (48 hrs).

oscar_design: Quick Qs: hero image style? abstract shapes vs device mock? and do we want a GIF for story?

mai_pm: Abstract shapes only, no device mockups. MP4 preferred for story loop (small). Keep hero static for email.

tess_copy: Copy payload: primary headline "Predictable inference, lower unit cost"; alt headline "Ship LLM features with consistent latency"; subhead "Jun 12 webinar: demo + benchmarks"; CTAs: "Register" / "Save my seat". I'll push FR/NL strings by tomorrow 9am PT. Also adding short alt text for accessibility.

oscar_design: For the benchmark slide: do you want axis ticks & numeric labels?

mai_pm: Yes, axis labels & minimal ticks. Legend with 3 points and small captions. Callout bubble: "Smart routing & caching lowers effective cost". Use teal + warm orange; avoid alarm red (#c63232).

laura_i18n: Please keep every string in its own editable text layer and provide a CSV page in Figma. Avoid idioms so translations are clean. NL will need slightly different length allowances.

ben_legal: No competitor logos or named comparisons. If using customer quotes or logos, include signed permission. Also if anyone plans to include specific numerical claims (e.g., "30% cheaper"), attach the data source. I can review final assets within 2 hours.

figma-bot: New file created: Jun12-Launch-MiniPack. Frames: hero-1600x600, hero-email-1200x628, slide-1920x1080, teardown-1200x600, social-square-1080x1080, social-story-1080x1920, linkedin-1200x627, svg-diagram. Link: https://figma.com/file/example-jun12 (placeholder).

oscar_design: I'll set up frames per locale and keep copy editable. Exports: PNG for email/web, WebP for social, SVG for diagrams, PDF for deck. ETA first comps: tomorrow 11am PT.

tess_copy: I'll drop final copies plus two CTA microvariants by 8:30am PT to hit localization.

laura_i18n: If source strings arrive by 9am, FR/NL translations doable within 12 hours. Please keep CTAs under 20 chars.

mai_pm: Priority order: 1) landing hero + CTA, 2) benchmark slide, 3) social. If timeline slips, benchmark should still be ready for the deck. Ping legal for quick brand check on finals. Any blockers, call them out here. :raised_hands:
